newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Opposition calls for job sharing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Opposition calls for job sharing.

text.p: Australian opposition employment spokesman Martin Ferguson said on Friday that a job sharing option should be considered to reduce unemployment.

"We think a live option out there in the community is to float the concept of a sharing of work through workers basically deciding, those who have got jobs, to work a fewer number of hours on the basis that they all contribute to the creation of additional jobs," Ferguson told Australian Broadcasting Corp Radio.

Australian unemployment reached a 1930s post-depression record of 11.0 percent in 1992. It fell rapidly after that. It stopped falling in 1995 at 8.4 percent. The trend rate has crept up since then to reach 8.7 percent in December.
